import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem complex_scaled_bilinear_of_square_neg_one (a b c s : ℂ) (h₀ : a + b = s * c) (h₁ : c * c = -1) : a * c + b * c = -s := by
  have h₂ : a * c + b * c = (a + b) * c := by ring
  rw [h₂]
  have h₃ : (a + b) * c = s * c * c := by rw [h₀]
  rw [h₃]
  have h₄ : s * c * c = -s := by
    calc
      s * c * c = s * (c * c) := by ring
      _ = s * (-1) := by rw [h₁]
      _ = -s := by ring
      _ = -s := by rfl
  rw [h₄]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem complex_scaled_bilinear_of_square_neg_one (a b c s : ℂ) (h₀ : a + b = s * c) (h₁ : c * c = -1) : a * c + b * c = -s := by
  have h₂ : a * c + b * c = (a + b) * c := by
    ring
  rw [h₂]
  have h₃ : (a + b) * c = (s * c) * c := by
    rw [h₀]
  rw [h₃]
  have h₄ : (s * c) * c = s * (c * c) := by
    ring
  rw [h₄]
  have h₅ : c * c = -1 := h₁
  rw [h₅]
  ring_nf
  <;> simp [Complex.ext_iff, pow_two, Complex.I_mul_I]
  <;> ring_nf
  <;> simp_all [Complex.ext_iff, pow_two, Complex.I_mul_I]
  <;> nlinarith
